int_name: N BROAD ST & W RUSCOMB ST

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, signals, and a median refuge island. However, the wide multi-lane configuration and significant crossing distance create a car-centric environment with high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic while crossing.

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks and degradation in the asphalt surface within the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane or unused road space to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to allow pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and overhead traffic signals within a commercial district. However, the environment lacks physical pedestrian protections like curb extensions or refuge islands, and parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection curb line may block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and a small pedestrian refuge island. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, pedestrian signals, and a bus shelter are present, the large crossing distance and car-centric scale create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway may pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle control.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk area to eliminate trip hazards and improve traction.
